title: How do I post a Club Membership enrollment fee charge?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Club Membership one-time enrollment fee charge: when it applies and how to post it.

## Applicable situation
The enrollment fee charge applies at activation of a Club Membership contract, or at any later point at which it is discovered that a membership contract's own one-time enrollment fee charge was never posted to its billing history. The amount actually billed is determined by this policy's own governing basis for the enrollment fee charge.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked and then called: charge_enrollment_fee_91320c6d.

## Parameters
- membership_id: which membership contract this charge belongs to; look this up from the member's own membership holdings first.
- customer_id: which member owns that contract; also found via the member's profile or membership holdings.
- amount_usd: the dollar figure to charge for this enrollment fee, expressed in US dollars to exactly 2 decimal places; always required, and never a negative figure.

## Return
On success, the call hands back a reference number for the newly posted billing entry, together with the contract and dollar figure just billed. Where no such membership contract exists on file, the call instead reports that fact in its own return text rather than raising an error.

## Points of judgement
Invoking charge_enrollment_fee_91320c6d twice for one contract does not correct anything already on file; the second call simply adds a further, separate enrollment-fee entry alongside the first.
